title: AE Services for Ten Artificial / Synthetic Turf Infields
short_description: Design-build services for synthetic turf infields at ten baseball and softball fields.
project_location: Bowling Green and Alvaton, Warren County, Kentucky, USA
project_scope: Request for proposals for design, engineering/architectural, construction, and installation of synthetic/artificial infield turf at ten sports fields across four park complexes. Locations include Michael O. Buchanon Park Upper Complex (4 fields, each 300-foot, currently dirt infields), Phil Moore Park Complex (Field 1: 210-foot, current dirt infield; Field 2: 200-foot little league field, current grass infield), Ephram White Park Complex (2 fields, each 225-foot, currently dirt infields), and Basil Griffin Park Complex (2 fields, each 300-foot, currently dirt infields). Required configurations include multiple pitching distances/circles ranging from 35 to 50 feet and base distances ranging from 60 to 70 feet depending on field.
services: Integrated design-build services including design, engineering/architectural services, construction, and installation for synthetic turf infields; disciplines requested include architecture services, interior design/space planning, landscape architecture, programming, and rehabilitation/refurbishment.
relevance_explanation:
- Sports-related project, but limited to synthetic turf infields rather than structural or long-span engineering.
- No bridge, roof, grandstand, stadium structure, or other complex load-bearing system is described.
- Scope is primarily surface replacement and field installation, which is outside sbp's core structural engineering focus.
- Includes design and engineering, but not for a technically demanding structure relevant to sbp.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated in the tender documents. The scope covers ten synthetic/artificial turf infields at baseball/softball fields sized approximately 200 to 300 feet, across four park complexes in Warren County, Kentucky. This information may support a later cost estimate, but no reliable USD figure can be derived from the provided text alone.
fee_explanation: No fee information is explicitly available. The tender is for integrated design, engineering/architectural, construction, and installation services, so a separate planning fee for sbp cannot be identified from the provided text.
references_qualifications: Mandatory pre-bid meeting attendance is required; only companies attending a pre-bid meeting may submit a proposal. No specific technical reference requirements or qualification thresholds are stated in the provided text.

notes: Project #865687; ProjectID 1009127. Stage: RFP/RFQ. Mandatory pre-bid meeting by appointment during listed time frames; solicitation documents available online. Although categorized under sports, the tender concerns field surfacing rather than stadium or structural engineering.
